problems: The Plant Keeper's red-on-red apron straps lose contrast on the first wearer. Its identity depends too heavily on the small plant and thin pocket outlines.
The Mayor's scissors have gold handle loops that appear disconnected from the central hinge and blades. This weakens an otherwise effective ceremonial prop.
The tour guide's flagpole intersects the sleeve envelope: its centre is at z=0.09 while the sleeve extends to z=0.095. It needs clearance and an explicit hand grip.

The maintenance cap becomes almost indistinguishable from hair on the second wearer because its inherited brown colour blends with the head. The hi-vis vest remains clear, but the head silhouette is inconsistent.

Round 2 is clearly better than round 1. The hi-vis vest, the open cardigan with the tote, the flag-pole guide and the plant in a pot all read now. The age is right: hoodie with drawstrings, hi-vis, suit and tie, lanyard, wheeled suitcase and phones are all contemporary, with no anachronisms.

Plant Keeper: the 'hair:light' box at head [0.09,0.31,0.025], size [0.18,0.12,0.23], renders as a pale grey cube stuck to the side of the head on both wearers. From above it is the most visible thing on the kit and reads as a bandage or an ice block, not as textured hair.
Mayor: the 'hair:light' sphere at head [-0.065,0.323,0.065] renders as a white egg-shaped blob on top of dark hair, and it pulls the eye away from the insignia.

Canvas-Jacket Neighbour and Sunhat Library Regular have almost the same torso: an open front in the 'shirt' role, a light centre strip and two square lower pockets, in the same colour on the same wearer. With the hat removed they are the same kit. The Canvas-Jacket Neighbour has no headgear, no bag and no silhouette feature apart from a small bun and a 0.1 m phone, so from above it reads as a default villager.

Sunhat Library Regular: the crown is a straight-sided flat-topped cylinder with a band, and the brim sits at y 0.325, level with the top of the head. It reads as an old-fashioned straw boater perched on the head, not a modern sun hat.

Town Maintenance Worker: the cap is a 'hat'-role sphere, so it changes colour per wearer (yellow, then brown that blends into the skin). It reads as a beanie or shower cap, and the 0.035 brim is barely visible. The dark knee pads at legL/legR y -0.4 look like a second pair of boot tops, so the legs read as boot, jeans, boot. The toolbox (x -0.035, width 0.32 on armR) reaches about 0.03 m into the leg's swing path.

Mayor: the two gold rings with dark centres at hand height read as binoculars or goggles, not ceremonial scissors. The open grey blades hang down and get lost against the trousers. The red V in the right hand reads as an awareness ribbon or red pliers. The lower end of the 0.7 m sash at rotation -0.57 sticks out about 0.02 m past the torso edge (x about -0.25) into the right sleeve and will clip the swinging arm. The all-#4c555e suit makes a dark rectangle that does not look grand. The sash and badge are the only office cues and the badge is small.

Far-Routes Tour Guide: the jacket is the same fixed #efb749 as the maintenance vest, so the leader and an everyday worker share their main colour. The crown is a tall straight cylinder (0.2 h) on a flat brim, which reads as a teal bowler or pork-pie hat, not a bucket hat. The wheeled suitcase is carried at the side with its wheels floating about 0.11 m above the ground. The flag pole runs along the sleeve's front face (z 0.09, inside the 0.095 sleeve half-depth), so it is partly sunk into the arm.
Sunhat Library Regular: the shoe override [0.2,0.09,0.28] nearly matches the base shoe [0.19,0.09,0.27], so the dark base shoe shows through as a band on the second wearer.
fix:
Plant Keeper: Retain the hoodie, cropped trousers and potted plant. Enlarge the apron into a continuous bib approximately 0.36 wide by 0.40 high, joining the straps, and give it a reliably contrasting light neutral or sage colour with one dark pocket. Remove the tiny drawstrings if they compete with the straps. Canvas-Jacket Neighbour: Keep the collar, rolled cuffs and phone; this kit already reads as a modern casual neighbour. Preserve the bright phone screen rather than adding smaller details. Sunhat Library Regular: Keep the broad pale hat, cardigan, book and tote; these provide a successful silhouette distinct from the canvas jacket. Maintain strong book-cover and bag contrast across wearer palettes. Town Maintenance Worker: Preserve the reflective vest and chunky toolbox. Give both caps a fixed contrasting workwear colour and a clearly projecting dark visor, rather than inheriting a skin-adjacent brown. Mayor of the Civic Ribbon: Keep the dark suit, broad gold sash and civic badge. Add two substantial gold shanks connecting the handle loops to the scissors' hinge, overlap the blade roots with that hinge, and ensure one handle is visibly held. Far-Routes Tour Guide: Preserve the mint hat, red scarf, flag and suitcase as the visitor signature. Move the flag shaft forward clear of the sleeve, approximately z=0.14–0.16, and add a connected gripping-hand shape around its lower end. Slightly enlarge the suitcase wheels so the luggage remains recognisable without its tiny stickers. Recheck all six kits at the intended 40° camera and actual stream size. / Plant Keeper: delete the 'hair:light' box. Build loose textured hair from three or four overlapping 'hair' spheres (about 0.14-0.18 each) across the top and back of the head, with one slightly forward over the brow. Keep the hoodie, bib pouch, drawstrings and cropped ankles. Make the hood a readable rolled lump at the back of the neck, about [0.34,0.12,0.12] at hips [0,0.62,-0.14] in 'shirt:dark', so it shows from above. Scale the pot about 1.3x so it holds its own next to the toolbox.

Canvas-Jacket Neighbour: give it its own silhouette and colour. Change the jacket body and sleeves from 'shirt' to 'accent' (or 'pants:dark') so it never matches the cardigan on the same wearer. Make it a boxy chore coat: hem dropped to hips y about 0.0, a wide flat 'shirt:light' corduroy collar about 0.30 wide lying on the shoulders, and two chest flap pockets instead of low ones. Add a backpack: a 'shirt:dark' box about [0.32,0.36,0.14] at hips [0,0.32,-0.22], with two strap boxes over the shoulders to the front. This makes it unmistakable from the 40-degree camera. Enlarge the bun to about 0.18 and keep the phone.

Sunhat Library Regular: change the crown to a rounded dome (a sphere about [0.34,0.18,0.32] at y 0.33). Lower the brim to y about 0.27 so it sits on the brow, widen it to about 0.66 and keep it fixed #eee9d8, with a soft 'accent' band. Make the cardigan read as long and loose to set it apart from a jacket: drop the front panels to y about -0.02 (hips bone only), remove the square pockets and add a single 'accent:light' scarf or knit-collar ring at the neck. Make the book a thicker 0.05 block with a strong #315e83 cover so it does not read as a phone. Make the shoe override at least 0.02 larger in every dimension (or hide 'shoes') so the base shoe cannot show through.

Town Maintenance Worker: replace the cap with a fixed-colour hard hat. Use a #e1e3dc (or #efb749) dome sphere about [0.36,0.18,0.34] at y 0.33, plus a full flat brim ring as a cylinder about [0.42,0.03,0.40] at y 0.27, with a short front peak. Raise it so it never covers the eyes, and do not use the 'hat' role. Remove the knee pads or make them small light-grey (#a4aeaf) squares at 0.12 x 0.08 so they stop reading as boot tops. Move the toolbox to x -0.07 on armR so it clears the leg.

Mayor: delete the 'hair:light' blob and use one neat side-parted 'hair' cap plus a small 'hair' fringe box. Shorten the sash to about 0.62 and nudge it up and right so the lower end stays inside the torso width (|x| < 0.22). Make the badge a larger gold #efb749 disc, about 0.12, high on the sash at the chest, with the #315e83 diamond on it. Redesign the scissors so they read at a glance: hold them upright in front of the chest from the left hand, with two small gold rings (about 0.09) stacked at the grip and one closed silver #a4aeaf wedge blade about 0.32 long pointing up, not down. Replace the red V with a broad red #d9534f ribbon band about 0.40 x 0.06 held horizontally from the right hand, with a bow at the hand. For grandness, add a 'shirt' or #315e83 pocket square and lapel rosette, and make the suit jacket longer at the back (hips box hem to y about -0.08).

Far-Routes Tour Guide: change the jacket from #efb749 to a colour no everyday kit uses, such as #d9534f red with the #68b4a0 hat, or #68b4a0 teal jacket with a #efb749 hat, so the leader is never confused with the maintenance worker. Make the hat a real bucket hat: a crown about [0.34,0.13,0.32] cylinder at y 0.34, plus a downward-sloping brim made of a cone (or four boxes tilted about 0.35 rad) reaching to about 0.48 wide and sitting at y about 0.26. Move the flag pole to z about 0.14 so it sits in front of the sleeve, not inside it, and keep the flag big. Either lower the suitcase so the wheels touch y about -1.33 (the ground, in the arm frame) and tilt it about 0.3 rad back so it is pulled, or drop the wheels and carry it as a holdall. Keep the scarf, lanyard and map, which read well.

All kits: re-render on both bodies and check from the 40-degree stream camera that each everyday kit is identifiable from headgear, back or held item alone: Plant Keeper by the hood and pot, Canvas-Jacket Neighbour by the backpack and collar, Sunhat Library Regular by the brim and tote, Town Maintenance Worker by the hard hat and hi-vis.
